verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a code-first framework: its full scene graph (lights, cameras, materials, meshes, animations, GUI, actions) is exposed through typed NPM/ES6 APIs, and it can run headless via NullEngine and server-side support. That makes programmatic control its primary interface, with visual tools like the Inspector and Node Material Editor layered on top. However, no evidence states that every visual-tool operation has a programmatic equivalent, and there is no OpenAPI or MCP surface for agents. Missing for 10: documented parity between Inspector/NME/Sandbox actions and the code API, an agent-facing API surface (OpenAPI/MCP), and independent hands-on confirmation of full UI-to-API parity.
